headers.comment: The executor. 'unsafe-eval' is required by new Function and is confined to this one path; the frame runs at an opaque origin because the parent frames it with sandbox=allow-scripts and no allow-same-origin. The script is inline because 'self' does not match an opaque origin in a CSP source list.

Everything except /sandbox/. The negative lookahead matters: two matching rules would both apply, and multiple CSP headers are enforced as an intersection, which would strip 'unsafe-eval' back out of the executor.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self'; frame-src 'self'; base-uri 'none'; object-src 'none'; form-action 'none'
